title: Protocol gate single final verdict
problem: tnf protocol gate prints ALL PROTOCOLS PASSED then CI session-handoff BLOCKED exit 1 — dual narrative trains overrides.

solution.summary: Defer overall PASS/FAIL until all subgates finish; print provisional section results; one final verdict line + exit code.
steps: Locate ProtocolInterceptor success banner; change to 'Preflight sections OK (provisional)'.
After CI subgates, print exactly one of: VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL with reasons.
Add regression test fixture simulating preflight ok + handoff gate block → must not contain 'ALL PROTOCOLS PASSED' as final banner.
verify: tnf protocol gate --no-splash; if fail, stdout contains VERDICT: FAIL and does not end with ALL PROTOCOLS PASSED

acceptance_probe: Single VERDICT line; exit code agrees; no premature ALL PASSED finality.
